findings.text: follow-on: an identical _write_run_row helper is added here and again at scripts/backfill_run_durations.py:247, so one mechanism — rewrite a run's own file through serialize_run — now has two copies beside ledger.py's own _keep_run_files_identical at reckon/ledger.py:1554 that already rewrites a run file the same way.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against base 2e9a07c237; seven commits change reckon/ledger.py, five production writers, one fixture, the fold test and one evidence fragment, all inside the declared scope.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names tests/test_the_ledger_writer_refuses_a_fold.py over a 10-row aggregate and 50 per-run files; logs/attempt2-gate-final.log records "14 passed" EXIT=0 and logs/attempt2-negative-control-final.log records "9 failed" EXIT=1 for the same file one revision apart, so the gate asserts the refusal naming 50, the accepted one-run append and the unchanged hold count.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is to make ledger.write refuse a write that folds per-run rows into the aggregate with record_hold_checks reading the aggregate's own rows; reckon/ledger.py:1835 adds the refusal and reckon/ledger.py:3798 makes record_hold_checks read the aggregate's own rows, which is exactly the goal.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records the head gate 14 passed EXIT=0 at 80a282c4b, the pre-guard base arm 9 failed EXIT=1, the seven-file arm 154 passed EXIT=0 and the fourteen-file arm 278 passed with 2 failed before the register_member repair, and it names every log on disk.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the node's original scope was three paths, extended by the resume advice of 2026-10-17 to cover the five repaired writers, the register_member repair and the hold-check fixture; every path the diff changes lies inside that union.

justifications.durability: tests/test_the_ledger_writer_refuses_a_fold.py:113 fails when the guard is removed, as logs/attempt2-negative-control-final.log shows the base tree accepting the union write, and the asserted "fold 50" is the fixture's own PER_RUN_FILES constant rather than a value handed to write.
justifications.evidence: logs/attempt2-gate-final.log ends "14 passed" EXIT=0 and logs/attempt2-negative-control-final.log ends "9 failed" EXIT=1 over tests/test_the_ledger_writer_refuses_a_fold.py, so the done_when's cases are measured and logged; the ruff no-added-finding clause is a recorded delta with no standalone log.
justifications.fit: _folded_run_ids at reckon/ledger.py:892 and load_aggregate at reckon/ledger.py:960 follow the module's existing helper idiom and name their mechanism with no plan or ticket label.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/ledger.py:1835 refuses an incoming row whose per-run file exists and names how many would fold, and reckon/ledger.py:3798 reads the aggregate's own rows, which is exactly the node's goal.
justifications.reuse: load_aggregate wraps the existing _load_aggregate owner rather than forking it, but scripts/derive_run_figures.py:93 and scripts/backfill_run_durations.py:247 carry one identical _write_run_row between them beside ledger.py's own _keep_run_files_identical at reckon/ledger.py:1554.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in git diff 2e9a07c237..80a282c4b is inside the original three write paths plus the six the resume advice of 2026-10-17 added.
